decision.rationale: Retain V2.1 as the prospective implementation candidate because it adds a finite durable goal and outreach lifecycle while passing every frozen control, lineage, persistence, restart, and termination development gate. Do not promote it into the release profile before provider-backed and held-out evaluation.
limitations: This is synthetic network-free development qualification, not professor fidelity, student usability, learning-outcome, or natural LLM quality evidence.
The no-autonomy control is defined by its disabled policy rather than a second seven-day execution.
The run used a disclosed dirty candidate working tree based on cfd38fe; file and instrument hashes bind the tested implementation.
